title: History asks the server: filtered, keyset-paged analyses on one shared kp_fold
deviations_from_card: (1) Write set shrank: jobs.ts/devcase-ledger.ts/analyses.ts/route.ts/History* as carded; HistoryTable.tsx untouched. HistoryTypes.test.ts (the existing colocated test of HistoryTypes.ts) was edited: two source guards pinned the retired client matcher and the Showing-of-total copy; re-pinned to the server path (toSearchParams, readHistoryPage, showingFirst/showingMatched, Load more) and still forbid historyRowMatchesQuery/foldForSearch, a bare toLowerCase needle, a client NFD fold and a Showing-of-total over a slice. (2) listAnalysesPage keeps a numeric overload (listAnalysesPage(100, ws)) so every existing caller (listAnalyses, candidate-timeline, palette, tests) is unchanged. (3) The route test uses a fixture-unique family (fx_route_data) instead of data_ai: the unit DB self-seeds demo analyses that already carry data_ai, so the card's literal exact-fit case would never be exact. (4) Catalog: added history.loadMore/showingMatched/showingFirst and, in a second locked commit, removed the three keys the retired slice copy used (showing, showingLoaded, truncated). (5) The 'undecided' filter matches disposition IS NULL OR '' (the client read == null; a stored '' is the same 'no decision'). (6) Facets are read over the KEPT (newest-per-group) rows, the set the filters test, so no offered value can only answer 'no match'. (7) Extra acceptance beyond the card's 8: malformed cursor / unknown disposition fall back, and the numeric overload keeps the old contract.
notes: Red-before: 17 of 18 new cases red at 01a21e1f7 (text-fold 4/4, store 6/7, route 2/2, client 5/5); the numeric-overload guard was green before by design. Both registration orders are real process histories: the test closes and unsets globalThis.__kpDb between cases. Keyset: ORDER BY created_at DESC, slug DESC with (created_at < ? OR (= ? AND slug < ?)); cursor = base64url JSON [created_at, slug]; malformed cursor reads as page 1 (client merges by slug). Group tie-break stays rowid (which row is newest); page order tie-break is slug. Read-only card: no read->write, no new error code (store faults keep ANALYSES_LIST_FAILED), no auth change (route still requireCapabilityCoded('read')), no schema, SQL keeps workspace_id = ? inline (analyses-tenancy guard green). GATES: tsc 0 on my paths (whole tree red only on sibling in-flight files: stage-hooks.ts, voice/readiness, ScheduleInterviewPrepPlanDiff, jobseeker). api:check 1 = /api/voice/readiness undocumented (sibling); my route's methods and auth side are unchanged. test:unit 1 = only the known environmental python-runner-concurrency process-tree case. review:constitution --base f43d8320c 1 blocking = route-auth-posture at app/api/voice/readiness/route.ts (sibling, not in my commits) + a note on rate-limit-contract.test.ts (sibling); nothing on my files. Raised exactly that in 3f941e27a: 12 existing overrides bumped with a why; devcase/control, devcase/lifecycle and jds/[slug]/retry-analysis got named overrides instead of lifting the group default. With the budget applied, base+card measured clean except app/page.tsx. Committed HEAD 45ec3d931 check-budget: the ONLY finding is app/page.tsx 1450 modules vs 1449, a sibling's committed share (it was already 1449 vs 1446 before my UI; later sibling raises covered part) - for the wave settle. The working tree shows more KB overages (companion, repo-scan, devcase/inbound, +5-9 KB on the task-hub routes) coming only from siblings' UNCOMMITTED files. INTEGRATION: cv-analyze-workspace/B rebases HistoryTab.tsx: rows are now replaced per query (page 1) and appended by loadMore; the filter state is q/appliedQ (debounced)/roleFamily/seniority/disposition; B's applyDecision should update `rows` in place and, with the 'undecided' filter on, a decided row may be dropped locally (a refetch would drop it server-side). HistoryFilterBar props changed (filteredCount/totalCount -> answersFilter/shownCount). devcase-lifecycle/B: devcase-ledger.ts now only calls registerKpFold(db) at the end of ledgerStore() and folds the needle with foldText; the index creation and SQL are untouched. Other client-side folds (profile roster, analytics audit log, journey filters) still carry their own foldForSearch over their own loaded lists; out of this card's scope.
loop_open: none: the card adds no refusal, gate or stored status. The one surface that displayed the old slice semantics (the truncated banner and Showing-of-total copy) was retired in the same card, and its catalog keys removed.
